NOTE
**Still not ready — UI change has no screenshots**

New: Squashed the history into one commit with a proper summary line, which was the only thing asked for. Missing: before/after screenshots of the Manage User form with the editable email field, and of the new notification email, since the PR description says none are needed.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until screenshots are added; then remove it, add "maintainer review", and assign Sahil Batra, who has changed these files often.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the history, that looks good now. Since this makes the email field editable in the Manage User panel, could you add before/after screenshots of that form (and of the new notification email)? See the [guide to making reviewable PRs](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html).
```
